verdict.rationale: Obsidian Publish is a first-party hosted service. The docs say it publishes notes as a "digital garden", and that you select notes and press Publish to host them at publish.obsidian.md, with custom domains supported. That covers selective publishing to a browsable site. However, the evidence never confirms that internal links resolve on the published site, and it does not explicitly state that the whole workflow happens inside the app. missing for 10: documentation that internal links and backlinks work on the published site, explicit confirmation that publishing happens entirely in-app, independent or hands-on corroboration of Publish.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can publish selected notes as a browsable website — a digital garden with working links — without leaving the app

citations.quote: Obsidian Publish is a cloud-based hosting service that lets you publish your notes as a wiki, knowledge base, documentation, or digital garden.
Select the notes you want to share with the world, press Publish, and we'll host it at publish.obsidian.md/your-site
Custom domains - Set up Publish with your own domain.
